# Crystalloid Fluids(Archived)

**Authors:** Eric M. Epstein, Preeti Patel, Muhammad Waseem

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Crystalloid fluids are a subset of intravenous solutions frequently used in the clinical setting. Crystalloid fluids are the first choice for fluid resuscitation in the presence of hypovolemia, hemorrhage, sepsis, and dehydration. Other clinical applications include intravenous medication delivery, delivering maintenance fluid in patients with limited or no enteral nutrition, blood pressure management, and increasing diuresis to avoid nephrotoxic drug or toxin-mediated end-organ damage.
